paragraphs: <strong style="font-family:'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', Verdana, Geneva, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:13px;background-color:#ffffff;">Business Card Policy</strong> <br style="font-family:'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', Verdana, Geneva, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:13px;background-color:#ffffff;"> <br style="font-family:'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', Verdana, Geneva, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:13px;background-color:#ffffff;"> <span style="font-family:'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', Verdana, Geneva, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:13px;background-color:#ffffff;">The following personnel are eligible for business cards:</span> <br style="font-family:'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', Verdana, Geneva, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:13px;background-color:#ffffff;"> <ul style="font-size:13px;font-family:'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', Verdana, Geneva, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;background-color:#ffffff;"> <li style="font-size:1em;">executive-level employees</li> <li style="font-size:1em;">manager-level employees</li> <li style="font-size:1em;">professional staff (exempt)</li> <li style="font-size:1em;">sales executives and account managers</li> </ul> <strong style="font-family:'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', Verdana, Geneva, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:13px;background-color:#ffffff;">Identification and Title</strong> <br style="font-family:'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', Verdana, Geneva, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:13px;background-color:#ffffff;"> <br style="font-family:'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', Verdana, Geneva, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:13px;background-color:#ffffff;"> <span style="font-family:'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', Verdana, Geneva, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:13px;background-color:#ffffff;">On business cards, individuals should be identified by the official title assigned to them upon being hired. Variations on titles are permissible at the department head's discretion.</span> <br style="font-family:'Segoe UI', 'Open Sans', Verdana, Geneva, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;font-size:13px;background-color:#ffffff;">
